meta.title: Oshi Life | iPhone app for oshi events, lottery results and spending
meta.description: An iPhone app that turns photos of tickets and receipts into drafts of events, expenses and goods. Keep track of lottery deadlines, results and what you spend on your oshi.
meta.ogTitle: Snap a photo, and the draft is ready | Oshi Life
meta.ogImageAlt: The Oshi Life logo and the app's Home screen

hero.eyebrow: An app for recording your oshi life · Oshi Life {appVersion}
hero.headline:
Snap a photo,
and the draft is ready.
hero.lead: Take a photo of a ticket or receipt, and Oshi Life drafts the event, expense or goods for you. Check it and save, and the only typing left is whatever you want to fix. Manage entry deadlines, lottery results and what you spend on your oshi, all from your iPhone.
hero.note: On the Free plan, you can use Snap to Record {free.scansPerMonth} times a month (tickets and receipts combined). Premium has no limit.
hero.requirements: Free (with in-app purchases) · iPhone with iOS {minimumIOSVersion} or later

media.description: Animation: a receipt is photographed, split into a goods draft and an expense draft for each item, and added to this month's spending on Home.
screens: The Oshi Life Home screen. Below a card in your oshi's color are your next events, to-dos and this month's spending.

snap.headline:
Every item on the receipt
becomes goods and an expense.
snap.lead: You're back from a trip to see your oshi, typing in the receipts from your wallet one by one. Oshi Life turns that chore into snapping a photo and checking what it picked up.

points.title: Receipts, item by item
points.body: A receipt for an acrylic stand and a concert towel gives you one goods entry and one expense for each item. Tax and anything left over go into one expense under Other, and if the items can't be read, the total becomes one expense.

points.title: Tickets become events
points.body: It reads the title, date and time, venue, seat and price, and drafts an event. If the price was read, you can record the ticket price as an expense right after saving the event.

points.title: E-ticket screenshots too
points.body: Besides taking a photo, you can choose one from your library. If a ticket is read as a receipt or the other way around, you can read the same image again as the other kind.

snap.privacy: Scanning happens on your iPhone. Images and text never leave your iPhone for scanning.
snap.quota: The Free plan includes {free.scansPerMonth} scans a month (tickets and receipts combined). Premium has no limit.
snap.imageAlt: The Record screen, with Snap to Record at the top and the kinds of records below it.
snap.caption: Open it from any screen with the Record (+) button in the middle of the tab bar.

color.eyebrow: Your oshi's color and Dark Mode
color.headline:
Switch oshi,
and the app's color switches too.
color.lead: Buttons, tabs and card accents take on the color of the oshi you've selected. If your oshi's color is pink, the app goes pink; if it's mint, it goes mint.

points.title: A color for each oshi
points.body: Choose a color for each oshi, and the whole app changes color when you switch to that oshi.

points.title: Dark Mode too
points.body: By default it follows your iPhone's setting. You can also set it to always Light or always Dark under Appearance in the app's Settings.

media.description: Animation: the accent color on Home changes through the oshi colors one by one, then switches to Dark Mode.
screens: Home with a mint oshi selected.

schedule.headline:
No more screenshots
to remember entry deadlines.
schedule.lead: When you enter a ticket lottery, add the entry to Oshi Life. The entry deadline, results announcement and payment deadline show up in your events, and a reminder arrives as each one gets close.
schedule.timelineLabel: What happens after you add a lottery entry

timeline.title: Add the entry
timeline.body: Fill in the show you applied for and the dates and times of the deadline and the results announcement.

timeline.title: {lotteryDerivedEventCount} events appear
timeline.body: The entry deadline, results announcement and payment deadline are added to your calendar automatically.

timeline.title: Win, and the show date is added
timeline.body: Record a win and enter the event date, and the show is added as an event.

timeline.title: See your win rate
timeline.body: Record each result, and you can see your win rate so far.

points.title: Deadline reminders the day before
points.body: You're reminded of the entry deadline and the payment deadline the day before, and of the results at the time they're announced.

points.title: {premiumExtraReminderDays} days before and on the day
points.body: On top of the day-before reminder, you're also reminded of the entry deadline and the payment deadline {premiumExtraReminderDays} days before and on the morning of each deadline.

points.title: Lottery Board
points.body: Switch to Result with the [Calendar | Result] toggle at the top of the Event tab, and your entries are sorted into "Entering", "Awaiting results", "Payment due", "Ready to go" and "Not selected".

points.title: {eventKindCount} kinds of events
points.body: Live shows, releases, streams, TV, radio, YouTube, goods and more. Type in any venue or oshi name you like.

schedule.imageAlt: The calendar in the Event tab, with the [Calendar | Result] switch and buttons for filtering by oshi at the top.
schedule.caption: With {oshiFilterMinimumCount} or more oshi, you can filter by oshi.

money.headline:
See what you spent this month
without a calculator.
money.lead: Tickets, goods, travel, hotels, food. Your expenses are totaled by oshi and by category, and you can look back month by month in the Money tab.

points.title: This month on one screen
points.body: The Money tab puts the total, the change from last month, the breakdown and the list on one screen.

points.title: Less typing
points.body: Add expenses you log often from a template. Set up subscriptions and membership fees as recurring expenses, and each payment is added automatically when it's due.

points.title: Goods and expenses together
points.body: Turn on "Also record as an expense" when you add goods, and the expense is recorded at the same time.

points.title: View by oshi
points.body: With {oshiFilterMinimumCount} or more oshi, you can filter the breakdown and the list by oshi.

points.title: Budget
points.body: Set a monthly budget, and what's left shows on Home and in widgets. You're notified when you reach {budgetWarningPercent}% of it and when you go over.

money.imageAlt: The Money tab, with this month's total and, below it, the breakdown and the list of expenses.
money.caption: Exporting expenses as CSV or PDF is a Premium feature.

oshi.headline:
On the train home,
write down tonight's setlist.
oshi.lead: Save each memory with photos and the setlist. Your oshi's page brings together their profile, anniversaries, goods and memories.

points.title: You choose what to share
points.body: For a memory you choose to share, the title, text and setlist can be read by others in Everyone's Reports. Photos are not shared.

points.title: Milestone days, celebrated
points.body: Days since you started supporting your oshi, birthdays, anniversaries. On a milestone day, Home celebrates it, and you can make a Milestone Card for free that day. You also get a notification at {anniversaryNotificationHour} a.m. on birthdays and anniversaries.

points.title: Your year on a card
points.body: Your yearly recap can be turned into a share card for free.

oshi.imageAlt: Your oshi's page, with anniversaries, goods and memories below the profile.
oshi.caption: "Your oshi in review" and the share cards for monthly recaps and anniversaries are Premium features.

more.headline: More you can do
more.lead: You can also use it from your Home Screen, your Lock Screen and Siri.

points.title: Widgets
points.body: The "Oshi" widget shows your oshi's photo, how many days you've supported them and the days until your next event. The "Countdown" and "This Month's Oshi Spending" widgets are Premium.

points.title: Lock Screen on show day
points.body: From {liveActivityLeadHours} hours before the show starts, a countdown to showtime appears on your Lock Screen, and in the Dynamic Island on iPhones that have one.

points.title: Event Guide
points.body: Put the date and time, venue, travel and hotel, and what to bring into one image and send it to the friends you're going with. By default, amounts are left out of the image.

points.title: Siri and Shortcuts
points.body: Add an event, check your next event or see this month's spending with Siri or Shortcuts.

points.title: Sign-in is optional
points.body: As a guest, you can use the same features as when you're signed in. Sign in later with Apple or Google, and your records come with you.

points.title: App lock
points.body: Require Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode to open the app.

plans.headline:
Start for free.
Go Premium to record more.
plans.lead: The Free plan has limits on how much you can record. If you reach a limit, you can still view, edit and delete everything you've recorded.

free.name: Free
free.summary: Free to use, with limits on how much you can record.
free.limitsCaption: How much you can record on the Free plan
free.note: Events created by the Lottery Board don't count toward the event limit. Entries that weren't selected and entries you've already paid for don't count as active entries.

premium.name: Premium
premium.summary: An auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Please check the App Store for prices.
premium.note: Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least {subscriptionCancelLeadHours} hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your iPhone's Settings after purchase.

premiumItems: No limits on oshi, events, expenses, goods or memories
Any number of lottery entries at once, with entry deadline and payment deadline reminders {premiumExtraReminderDays} days before and on the morning of each deadline, too
No limit on Snap to Record
Oshi budgets, with what's left on Home and in widgets, and alerts when you overspend
"Your oshi in review", plus monthly recap and anniversary share cards
Up to {photosPerMemory.premium} photos per memory (Free: {photosPerMemory.free}), with photos also saved to the cloud
Choose your app icon from {alternateIconCount} colors
Export expenses as CSV or PDF
The "Countdown" and "This Month's Oshi Spending" widgets

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If your question isn't here, send it from "Contact" at the very bottom of the page.

items.question: Are my photos sent anywhere?
items.answer: Scanning happens on your iPhone, and images and text never leave it for scanning. With Premium, receipts attached to expenses and photos in memories are also saved to the cloud.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. The Free plan has limits on how much you can record (see the table above). If you reach a limit, you can still view, edit and delete everything you've recorded.

items.question: Do I need to sign in?
items.answer: No. As a guest, you can use the same features as when you're signed in. Sign in later with Apple or Google, and your records come with you.

items.question: Can other people see my memories?
items.answer: Only memories you choose to share appear in Everyone's Reports. You decide one memory at a time, and photos are never shown to others.

items.question: Which devices and languages are supported?
items.answer: iPhone with iOS {minimumIOSVersion} or later. The app is available in Japanese, English, Korean and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional).
